title: Epic and Chronicle
bookshelves: Category: Biography, Literature and Literary studies
summary: The Poema de mio Cid is one of the oldest extant literary works in Castilian, and the most complete epic poem of the Spanish medieval period now known to us in a form close to that in which it was originally written, perhaps around 1200. But it was not the only early source for legends of the Cid, as the Crónica de veinte reyes, the quasi-historical Chronicle of Twenty Kings, demonstrates. This book, originally published in paperback in 1983 under the ISBN 978-0-900547-84-3, was made Open Access in 2024 as part of the MHRA Revivals programme.
